database.description: The SQL database, by display name, or null when there is none. A binding may send an object instead to also say which SQL provider it is.

name.description: The display name: the database or file name.

system.description: The SQL provider id, matching ui/store-marks.js: sqlite, postgresql, mysql, mariadb, mssql (also written sqlserver), and others the workbench has no mark for. The workbench shows that provider's mark and name instead of guessing from the database name.

binding.description: The binding serving the workbench, so guidance such as the `preview: false` snippet is written in the host's own language.

framework.description: The web framework, free text: "ASP.NET Core", "Express", "FastAPI", "Spring Boot", "Laravel".

role.description: Display label from the authenticated identity's role claim type.

observedSend.description: Supports Prefer: trace for advertised preview operations.

previewSessions.description: Supports preview sessions: POST /sendproof/_api/sessions, then Previews carrying Sendproof-Session that share one held transaction. See README.md, Preview sessions.

journeys.description: Arazzo 1.1 documents of journeys, each with its Sendproof expectations document. See docs/plans/journeys.md.

source.description: code: built from journey classes at startup; file: a registered Arazzo file.

dataStores.description: Data stores the binding has hooked and how Preview treats each. See data-stores.md.

previewUnavailable.description: Operations an API author marked preview: false, with the reason the UI shows.
